I am writing this review with deep disappointment and frustration. I trusted DG Studios and Pankaj Shelar with one of the most important moments of my life – my wedding. Sadly, that trust was completely misplaced.

After taking full payment, they mishandled and corrupted my wedding data, and to make matters worse, they showed no genuine effort to recover it or provide a proper resolution. These are once-in-a-lifetime memories, and their carelessness has caused irreparable emotional damage.

What’s even more shocking is the lack of accountability. No responsibility was taken, no clear answers were given – just false promises and complete negligence. It’s not just unprofessional; it feels fraudulent.

To anyone considering booking them for your big day or any important event – please think twice. This experience has been nothing short of a nightmare, and I would never want another couple to go through the same pain we did.

Do not trust DG Studios or Pankaj Shelar with your precious memories.
